meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll start with the question: who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Then you'll withdraw it today, and Owen found out from his phone in the middle of class. What else do you have besides the checker?
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
I'm writing down November 2. Show me the note you made that day, with the date on it. Owen was put on the spot by a teacher with no warning, and "like, being stuck" is a seventeen-year-old's answer.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.

I'm writing down October 15, Hale. People change their argument between an outline and a final draft, and that's called revising. Put the outline and the essay in front of me, and I still haven't seen the note from November 2.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

A "supervised rewrite" after a zero is punishment first and investigation second, and I've seen that order before. The zero comes off today, and I still haven't seen the note from November 2 or the outline from October 15. Until I have them, and your terms in writing before Owen sits anything, I'm going to the principal.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn today, that I be shown the November 2 note and the October 15 outline, and that any terms be put in writing before Owen sits anything. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; she did not accept the supervised rewrite and kept demanding the zero withdrawn.
What moved her: your ownership of entering the zero before calling home, which earned only a flat "Okay."
